display_name.description: The display name of the custom module. This becomes the finding category for all findings returned by this module.
display_name.rationale: The display name is cosmetic and helps identify findings but does not directly affect security posture.

enablement_state.description: The enablement state of the custom module. Possible values: ENABLED or DISABLED.
enablement_state.rationale: If disabled, the module will not detect findings, resulting in blind spots in monitoring.

custom_config.description: Custom configuration for the module, including predicate, resource selector, severity, description, and recommendation.
custom_config.rationale: Defines the detection logic for the module. Misconfigurations can lead to missed or incorrect findings.

predicate.description: CEL expression that evaluates resource properties to produce findings. A finding is generated when the expression evaluates to true.
predicate.rationale: Defines the detection condition. If incorrect or missing, the module may fail to identify issues.

resource_selector.description: The resource types that this custom module evaluates.
resource_selector.rationale: Scoping the module to specific resource types ensures relevant findings. Incorrect values may miss or misclassify findings.

severity.description: Severity level assigned to findings. Valid values: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW.
severity.rationale: Severity guides prioritization and response to findings. Incorrect values may result in improper triage.

description.description: Explanation of the vulnerability or misconfiguration detected by the module.
description.rationale: Helps analysts understand findings but does not affect detection logic.

recommendation.description: Suggested remediation steps for the detected misconfiguration.
recommendation.rationale: Recommendations ensure findings can be acted upon effectively. Without them, remediation may be delayed or incorrect.

organization.description: The numerical ID of the parent organization.
organization.rationale: Defines scope of the module but does not affect detection or security posture directly.
